answer: Continuous attention slotting. Each identity holds one live slot; random stream checks need context-correct replies within 90 seconds. The wharf keeps an identity only while its slot stays occupied. Tenure grows like a vine through uninterrupted daily sessions. Priority hits its zenith after 30 days without a miss. An attacker needs one dedicated attention worker per identity (30 min daily plus random replies); N sybils consume N workers and forfeit output, while missed checks reset tenure.
